title: NYSE market calendar (Gate 0 source of truth)

years_covered.description: dca_runner.market_day_status() raises CalendarCoverageError for any date whose year is not in this list, rather than guessing whether the exchange is open.

holidays_closed.description: Full-day closures. dca_runner._calendar_dates() parses every entry with date.fromisoformat(), so each must be a real calendar date in extended YYYY-MM-DD form.

early_close_1300.description: Days the exchange closes at early_close_time_et (1:00 PM ET). Any slot at or after that time must end silently on these days.
